fomod.Name: O'Blood, Dirt and Cum
fomod.Author: That Guy (Coronerra)
fomod.Description: SkyrimNet companion for Dirt and Blood - Dynamic Visuals and/or OCum. Each is optional and detected automatically; you need at least one. With Dirt and Blood (a companion, not a replacement): plain-fact dirt and blood in character bios, state and bath events, bath memories, and a WashUp action for followers that uses Dirt and Blood's own bath and its soap and water rules. With OCum: NPCs know when someone has cum on them. With both: any real Dirt and Blood bath also washes OCum's cum off, with a short SkyrimNet narration. Adults only.
